content: Morning, could you log notes for Project KelpCircuit? It's the sixth one I'm running. Marta Ellingsen just started assisting me out in the field, please add her to the calendar invite.
Quick favor between calibrations, Baltic Acoustic Supply is now supplying all our gear, can you save their contact? And please book time in Fjordtest Basin North tomorrow for the tank tests.
When you get a sec, please file today's files under DA-4470 in the archive. I want to keep everything together before the meeting.
Morning, could you nudge purchasing about PR-6034? I filed it for the new cables. Also I need to return the borrowed field kit by 2026-12-15, so set a reminder.
Who is my second lab mate?
That was a bit long, just the value alone next time please, thanks!
The seminar tomorrow is in Room 214, I'm still finishing slides. NordCal Acoustics is calibrating our array this week, hope results come back in time.
Harbor Review Board looks at our project next month, so I'm pulling the progress notes together this afternoon, can you help format them?
